subject: Request: Escrowed stipend & cohort discount for Nexus Labs accelerator
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@nuselabs.co>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-06-12T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot program — cohort stipend & credits (SOW attached)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking a look. Quick background: Nexus Labs runs a virtual accelerator (next cohort starts July 20). We bring 18 early-stage teams and provide each with a $1k stipend for cloud/compute, which we want to disburse directly to founders. We typically secure a single partner to underwrite the stipend, and in the past the partner either paid founders directly or paid us and we distributed funds.

Two asks for Redwood:
1) Can Redwood hold a pool of credits on the Nexus Labs account (escrow-style) that we can draw down to pay stipends or reimburse teams post-milestone?
2) Can Nexus get a cohort-level pricing exception — a 30% discount on your Hosted/Dedicated starter tier for 6 months while teams ramp? We expect modest usage initially (~50k tokens/week aggregate) but spiky during demo week.

We attached the SOW and a cohort list. If escrow isn’t possible, we could structure a pre-paid credit top-up and an invoice delay until 60 days after the cohort ends. We’d also need a simple addendum or contract note for audit.

Appreciate a quick read — can you loop in whoever owns accelerator partner pricing?

Thanks,
Samir Gupta
Director, Nexus Labs
Nexus Labs Programs <programs@nuselabs.co>
Attachments: Nexus_Accelerator_SOW.pdf, Cohort_List.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@nuselabs.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot program — cohort stipend & credits (SOW attached)

Hi Samir — thanks for the SOW and clear asks. Short answers first: we can hold credits on an account and do one-time top-ups; we generally don’t route funds to third parties, but there are a couple of mechanisms that get you the same economic outcome.

Ben (our AE) and Neha (sales ops) are cc’d — Ben will propose a commercial path and Neha will flag the billing/legal requirements. To help us size a proposal, can you confirm: 1) the total stipend pool you want Redwood to hold; 2) preferred invoicing cadence and whether Nexus needs a PO before we provision credits; and 3) any specific compliance/audit language legal must include for cohort reporting?

We can probably do a conditional cohort discount tied to committed top-up and a short addendum for the cohort period. If you can share an expected spend profile (week-by-week) that’d be ideal.

Call out: if you need funds disbursed to founders directly, we’ll need to work with Nexus to determine whether the stipend is a Redwood credit applied to teams’ accounts (recommended) or cash distributed (harder operationally).

Proposed next step: Ben will suggest a pricing + credit structure. Neha will outline billing flow (pre-pay vs credit-hold) and what docs we need for finance. I’ll review the addendum.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships — Startup Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@nuselabs.co>
Date: 2027-06-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot program — cohort stipend & credits (SOW attached)

On Jun 12, 2027, at 9:10 AM, Samir Gupta wrote:
> Hi Laura,
> 
> Thanks for taking a look. Quick background: Nexus Labs runs a virtual accelerator...

Samir — appreciate the context. Initial commercial proposal (high level):
- One-time credit-topup: Redwood provisions a $12,000 credit pool on the Nexus Labs account to cover the 18 x $1k stipends (we can do smaller or larger amounts).
- Conditional cohort discount: 25% off our Hosted starter rates for 6 months for any team accounts created under the Nexus cohort umbrella, subject to a minimum $5k committed top-up.
- Release mechanics: Credits live on Nexus account and we can allocate credits to individual team emails on request; alternatively we can issue credits to teams after they complete a milestone sign-off from Nexus.
- Invoicing: we can invoice immediately for the top-up or accept PO + 30 days net if Nexus requires delayed payment; finance will require a signed SOW and a billing contact.

Notes/constraints: we cannot pay founders directly; Redwood does not transmit cash to third parties. If Nexus needs funds to be wired to founders, that would have to be handled outside Redwood (e.g., Nexus pays founders and provides receipts). The credit-hold + allocation approach is what’s worked best for other accelerators.

I’ll attach a draft addendum for the cohort (accelerator-addendum-draft.pdf) with language on allocation, expiration, and reporting. If that layout works for Nexus we’ll route to Legal for a short review and Finance for tax/invoice terms.

Next steps: Samir — tell us the preferred top-up amount and whether you want allocation or milestone-triggered release. We’ll generate a quote and a DocuSign addendum.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Startup Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: accelerator-addendum-draft.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@nuselabs.co>
Date: 2027-06-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot program — cohort stipend & credits (SOW attached)

Hi all — quick ops clarification from Finance/Revenue Ops:
- We cannot escrow funds outside Redwood or issue payments to third parties on behalf of customers. What we can do: (A) preload credits on the Nexus Labs account that Redwood will apply to team sub-accounts on written Nexus instruction; or (B) issue consolidated invoices to Nexus and apply payments to the account balance (then Nexus manages distribution).
- Billing docs required: signed SOW or addendum, billing contact, and Nexus tax form (W-9 or equivalent if US based). If Nexus is outside the US we’ll need VAT/GST details.
- Invoicing terms: we support Prepay (invoice immediately), Net 30 with PO review, or Net 60 in special cases (requires Finance sign-off). For the cohort exception we can offer Net 30 with a PO + committed top-up.
- Reporting: we will provide a monthly usage statement for teams that receive credits; Nexus needs to approve the report template before first allocation.

Samir: please confirm the top-up amount (we recommend $12k to cover 18 x $1k stipends plus buffer) and whether you prefer allocation on-request or milestone-driven release. Once confirmed I’ll open an internal finance ticket and attach the draft addendum to the HubSpot deal (HS-47829).

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Samir Gupta <samir@nuselabs.co>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot program — cohort stipend & credits (SOW attached)

Thanks — that approach sounds workable. Nexus is happy to go with: a $12,000 credit top-up held on our Nexus account, milestone-triggered allocation (we’ll sign off on 3 milestones: onboarding, mid-program check, demo day), and a 28% cohort discount for 6 months (can we meet halfway on 28% vs 25%?).

We’ll provide the PO and W-9 by end of day Monday and accept the credit-hold model (we prefer Redwood to allocate credits to team emails when Nexus submits the milestone sign-off). Please attach the draft addendum to the HubSpot deal and send the DocuSign when ready.

I attached the cohort CSV for reference. Can we schedule a 20-minute call Wednesday to finalize details?

Best,
Samir
Director, Nexus Labs
Attachments: Cohort_List.csv
